verdict.rationale: Algolia offers server-side scheduled data pipelines: Algolia "keeps the schedule, the retries, and the transformations", configured in the dashboard without deploying code. The Crawler also turns web pages into records without manual work, and the CLI is pitched for scripts and CI workflows. These are narrow, ingestion-focused background jobs, not general autonomous automations. Agent Studio is documented only as conversational assistants grounded in search data, not as background-running agents. Missing for 10: general-purpose or agentic background automations (triggers, scheduled agent tasks), detailed docs on scheduling beyond ingestion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
